operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action, 30 feet, concentration 1 minute, +1 AC/saves and half-damage sharing; M/F uses focus. NEW: willing ally, conserved mandatory post-defense split, rounding, participation and life endpoints, no continued tether and ordinary-spell/class-engine separation. CONFLICT RULING: source-derived class access is rank 1; duplicate rank-2 block is retained as evidence only.
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. In initiative, expires at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application; retain that virtual marker through initiative changes, departure or death. Outside initiative, expires 60 seconds after application; entering initiative preserves that absolute deadline. An already-passed start never counts. Ends earlier when concentration ends. Also ends if either participant dies. Reaching 0 HP alone is not a separate ending condition; ordinary Incapacitated/concentration rules still apply.
operational.effect: The ally gains +1 AC and +1 to saves, subject separately to the strongest applicable flat bonus. After the ally's defenses and legal prevention, before temporary HP, transfer floor(remaining damage / 2) to you and leave the remainder on the ally. Keep the damage type. Your transferred share skips a second mitigation/prevention stage and cannot transfer again; apply your temporary HP, HP, applicable life-state protections, Wounds and concentration consequences normally. The ally retains the hit, failed-save, critical and attached-rider identity; you were not hit and did not fail that save merely because damage transferred.
operational.implementationStatus: REVIEWED authored operational-playtest manuscript; runtime and balance validation pending
operational.limitations: Use DAMAGE_SHARING_PLAYTEST.md: one transfer operation per original-recipient damage root, across all owners. A prior pre-mitigation split preempts this transfer; competing positive mandatory post-defense claims are chosen by the original target. The retained ally portion cannot subsequently be transferred again after this split. Complete the current packet's split and life consequences before concentration failure caused by that packet ends the bond; never undo a committed share. One Warding Bond per participating creature across all casters; casting cannot create chains or cycles. Initial range/line of effect are required, but no continuing distance or line-of-effect tether is imposed. This ordinary spell neither consumes nor increases the Paladin class redirection round ledger and grants none of its named healing/resource riders or proc permissions. Unrelated downstream triggers still require their own exact source authorization. Direct HP payments are not damage and cannot be transferred. Known/prepared access, class-level gates, legal components, line of effect, payment before resolution, concentration transitions, Dissonance, Refrain and class cadence follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. No automatic scaling or generic upcast.
operational.resolution: Automatic on legal casting. On each eligible positive incoming damage packet to the ally, apply the mandatory post-defense transfer described below; a rounded-zero transfer claims no transfer operation.
operational.scaling: None. The rank-2 duplicate grants no upgrade or extra effect.
